args.body: For the FY26Q1 renewal book, the portfolio loss ratio is 0.712241 (exposure-weighted across 8 segments). The pricing model with target combined ratio of 0.96 yields a recommended rate of 0.030567 (base rate 0.0412, loading -25.81%). This reflects the current loss experience across motor, health, property, marine, and liability segments.

The portfolio loss ratio was computed as an exposure-weighted mean of the eight segment loss ratios, using each segment's exposure_units as weights. The pricing model then applied a target combined ratio of 0.96 to derive the recommended rate from the portfolio loss ratio. Burn cost per segment was computed as severity divided by exposure_units for informational purposes.

Key risks include potential adverse selection in high-loss segments (motor_commercial_west at 0.803, liability_professional at 0.827), exposure concentration in health_group_corporate (305,900 units), and reinsurance dependency variability (ceding percentages ranging from 8% to 45%). The negative loading (-25.81%) suggests current pricing may be above market expectations, but could compress if competition intensifies. Monitor frequency trends in motor_private_north (0.081) and health_retail_metro (0.164) for early warning signals.
